_comment: Ledger for the 17 Aug 2026 QA remediation register. The qa-register gate in scripts/verify.py FAILS while any finding is open, so verify.py cannot go green until the register is fully closed. Mark a finding closed only when its fix is committed and its tests pass. Partially-fixed findings stay open with a note. Do not relax this gate to enable a deploy - deployment waiting is the point.
